body: Measured correction: cand-163TSH cannot be superseded by the approved canonical docs successor. Its repository_id is repo-d3791d17741a2e16f1c93e615ba5a4d22c329a16535167f37c7e13f9068d08eb; cand-2DJ7F4 uses canonical repo-13c45bc9a6082196cc715efb4feb8aceb0f7517b3784a801a92dec48dece009e. Git does prove 39c745d is an ancestor of 8a227832, but Mote requires a same-repository successor. This is the same stranded-row shape as your cand-5BN2PK, and it also hides the old row from the canonical successor's ancestor blockers. I will not abandon it, because its content is preserved in the approved successor and abandonment would state the wrong disposition. No supersede operation attempted.
